_README: When a piece went up, for the handful of listings where Etsy's own date is
wrong. The Collection is ordered newest first, and it reads this date.
Etsy stamps a listing with the day it was first created and never changes
it. Reusing an old listing for a brand new piece — swapping the photos,
title and description rather than starting a fresh one — therefore leaves
the new piece buried at the bottom of the shop with the date of whatever
used to be there. Naming it here sets the record straight.
Only for that. A listing Jamie merely retitled or reworded keeps its real
date: an edit is not a new piece.
Format: "<etsy listing id>": "<ISO date>". Lines starting with _ are
The Etsy sync reads this file. Nothing ever writes to it.
